title: UAS 57th anniversary panel on the 1966 popular uprising
reason: Not coded as a protest event: the contemporaneous report describes an organized commemorative and academic panel, not a collective protest action or a specific demand directed to Burkina Faso authorities or their policy.
notes: A LeFaso report says the panel drew a large crowd and summarizes critical discussion of successive coups and calls for civil society monitoring. The evidence confirms the panel occurred but not a state-directed collective claim. The prior UAS notice S025 was only a future announcement; post-event LeFaso reporting S030 supports execution. No participant count is reported.
